env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.purpose: Postgres connection for the running app and the Playwright integration suite; the recipe checks skip env validation and do not read it

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.purpose: Redis connection for the running app and the Playwright integration suite; not read by the recipe checks

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.purpose: Google OAuth client for sign-in in the running app and the Playwright integration suite; not read by the recipe checks

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.purpose: Google OAuth client secret for the running app and the Playwright integration suite; not read by the recipe checks

env.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
env.purpose: Google OAuth callback URL for the running app and the Playwright integration suite; not read by the recipe checks

env.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.purpose: Lets the Sentry plugin upload source maps during pnpm build; the build passes without it
